text: The Heart of Tirna Noch is found at Tirna Noch in Ardenweald.
Healing Hammer is an Azerite trait for Protection paladins. It can only be found on Quartius Breastplate, which was never implemented.
Healthy Judgment was an Azerite trait for paladins. It could only be found on Tertius Breastplate, which was never made available.

The Heart of the Empire is a throne room located on the higher reaches of Dazar'alor, right beneath the Great Seal. A large decorated gate leads to the stairs of the pyramid in the outside, and two smaller doorways behind the throne lead to a balcony overlooking the whole Port of Zandalar. Here King Rastakhan fought and fell against the Alliance invaders during the Battle of Dazar'alor.
Healthy Portalbellos are sold by Zaki at the Heart of the Forest in Ardenweald. This item lets you travel directly to the Wildseed cave in the Underweald.
Healing with Arcana is located in Nor'Danil Wellspring in Azsuna.

Hearthglen Pass (or simply the Pass) is a pass leading to Hearthglen in the Western Plaguelands. Taelan's Tower is located here, and the pass neighbours with Redpine Dell and Northridge Lumber Camp. Before the Cataclysm, the pass was patroled by the Scarlet Crusade, including Huntsman Radley and Cavalier Durgen. As of the Cataclysm, the area was taken and reinforced by the Argent Crusade, with patrols and ballistae stationed here. Redpine gnolls also intruded into the area.
The Heart of Zan'vess is the central area of Zan'vess seen during the Assault on Zan'vess. Commander Tel'vrak is fought here.

__NOTOC__ Hedrum the Creeper is an elite crystal spider that sometimes appears in Blackrock Depths. When a player enters the Ring of Law in the Depths, an arena event will occur where players have to face three waves of non-elite enemies and finally an elite mini-boss. Hedrum is one of six possible mini-bosses that could appear. The other ones are Anub'shiah, Eviscerator, Grizzle, Gorosh the Dervish, and Ok'thor the Breaker. Don't underestimate her low level - she can bring down groups in seconds.

Permanently increase the Stamina of an item worn on the chest, shoulders, legs, hands or feet by 8. Attaching causes the item to become soulbound. Armor kits fill the same virtual "slot" as enchantments and will overwrite any existing enchantments, or be overwritten by enchantments applied later.

Heffen Glitterbows is a gnome tinker. He was the inventor of the gnomish death ray. When he unveiled this weapon, his opus, even the bravest tinkers went pale. Weapons they liked, but this was above and beyond anything they had ever dreamed. Devices are supposed to help the user, they argued, not potentially cause his death! Not on purpose, anyway. The mechanisms inside his device are fueled by the life force of the user. His ludicrously dangerous weapon has become quite popular in the black markets of both Alliance and Horde camps.

Heavy Chan is a large pandaren from One Keg and the son of a wealthy alchemist. He was one of the ten volunteers who decided to take The Trial of the Red Blossoms in order to join the Shado-pan. During the first trial he was unable to remove his paw from the tiger brazier which housed coin he needed to take. As such with the mouth too small and hot Chan so saw no choice but to take the brazier itself. After reuniting with the other three who had taken the test he remarked that there no others behind him, causing Ten to silently wonder to himself if the other hopefuls had drowned, been frozen, or simply left once Chan took the brazier. Heartwood Grove is an area of the dream tree of Tirna Rowen. When the adventurer arrived, the grove had just been decided to be fully culled, the majority of the seeds stripped of anima and only three allowed to be relocated to Tirna Scithe, and the heart of Tirna Rowen taken to Tirna Vaal to help the survival of the remaining wildseeds. However, the Drust attacked before that could happen, and Droman Krelnor fell to the Drust and become possessed. Along with Niya, it was the home of Choofa and Te'zan.
